name: vclo-by-rohas
description: vCLO is a free, open-source AI legal-team orchestrator with one virtual Chief Legal Officer, nine specialist virtual lawyers, jurisdiction-pack routing, coordinated workflows and company-registry access.

interface.longDescription: vCLO gives lawyers and businesses one virtual Chief Legal Officer and nine specialist virtual lawyers, then combines them with installed jurisdiction counsel and legal skills. It coordinates complex matters such as M&A due diligence, contract negotiation, litigation and dispute-resolution preparation, compliance reviews, data-breach response and internal investigations. The separate India Counsel pack supplies Indian-law rules and skills.
defaultPrompt: Run buyer-side legal due diligence on this acquisition and consolidate the key risks.
Review this MSA for the customer, propose redlines, and prepare negotiation positions.
Prepare our litigation case strategy from these pleadings, evidence, and deadlines.
